label: TP
reason: Both findings represent real vulnerabilities: 1) java.util.Random() provides insufficient entropy for cryptographic use (session key generation), enabling prediction attacks; 2) User-controlled cookie value flows unsanitized to response.getWriter().println() creating XSS via string concatenation.

evidence.note: java.util.Random().nextLong() generates cryptographically weak random number for session key
Unsanitized user input from cookie value concatenated to response.getWriter() causing XSS
